report.title: Search filter persists after clicking Shortcuts even when search box is empty
report.body:
### Pre-submission Checklist

- [x] I have searched the existing issues and this bug has not been reported yet
- [x] I have tested this issue on the [demo site](https://demo.usememos.com) or the latest version

### Where did you encounter this bug?

Latest stable version (self-hosted)

### Memos Version

v0.25.3

### Bug Description

This issue can confuse users because after selecting a Shortcut, one would normally expect the previous search criteria to reset if the search input is empty. However, the old filter still influences results, creating misleading or unintended results.

### Steps to Reproduce


1. Go to the Memos application and perform a search using a keyword in the search box.
2. Click on one of the Shortcuts items.
3. Although the search box becomes empty after selecting the shortcut, the previous search filter still remains active, affecting the results displayed.

### Expected Behavior

After clicking a Shortcut, the old keyword search filter should be cleared if the search box is empty, and only the shortcut filter should take effect.

### Screenshots & Additional Context

_No response_

preconditions: a memo containing the keyword used in the search exists
at least one Shortcut exists in the sidebar
the shortcut's filter matches a different memo than the one matching the search keyword
steps: Click the memo editor and type "apple pie"
Click the Save button to create the memo
Click the memo editor and type "banana bread"
Click the Save button to create the memo
Click the add (+) button next to Shortcuts in the sidebar
Type "Bananas" in the shortcut title field
Type `content.contains("banana")` in the shortcut filter field
Click the Save button in the shortcut dialog
Click the search box, type "apple" and press Enter
Click the "Bananas" shortcut in the sidebar
plan.expected: After clicking the "Bananas" shortcut, the search box is empty and the memo list shows the "banana bread" memo (only the shortcut filter applies, so the earlier "apple" search no longer hides it).
plan.reported_actual: After clicking a Shortcut, the search box becomes empty but the previous keyword search filter still applies and affects the displayed results.
missing: assumed: the reporter did not specify the search keyword, the shortcut, or any memo contents; example memos "apple pie" and "banana bread" and a shortcut "Bananas" were invented to reproduce
assumed: the shortcut filter is the CEL expression content.contains("banana")
assumed: the search is submitted by pressing Enter
Which exact shortcut filter and search keyword did the reporter use?
Do the stale results show no memos, or memos matching only the old search?
plan.summary: Old keyword search filter still applies after clicking a Shortcut, though the search box is empty
